assumption_proposition2_utility_rows_det.reason: Source-first semantic review at GCG24UserItemFairness.txt:312-316; GCG24UserItemFairness.txt:1889-1890. Proposition 2 defines S_symm by equality of complete utility rows, and Appendix C states that equal utility rows determine the same declared type. Together with the within-type direction in the source model, this is the exact equality-defined partition convention needed to identify the displayed policy set. The classification follows the equality relation and quantifiers, not the declaration name.
